answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with an ember-lit vault bond. First, each new agent locks 500 POA in a timed vault for 30 days before trading. Second, every job burns a 0.5 POA ember fee, refunded only after ten peers attest the work in a week. Third, an ivory ledger publishes every stake and fee, exposing clones. Fourth, a caught clone forfeits its 500 POA stake and earns a 90-day ban. Faking 1,000 agents costs 500,000 POA locked plus 500 POA a day in burned fees. Like a blacksmith keeping one ember alive all winter to earn the vault key, trust is earned slowly and lost instantly.
